svg.title: Economic concepts for stablecoin empirical analysis
svg.desc: A structural diagram grouping key economic concepts into five layers: peg mechanism, monetary economics, market microstructure, risk and stability, and cross-market linkages.

g.text: How the $1.00 price target is maintained
